Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer continued repeatedly running the same search query without effectively modifying or expanding the strategy to gather new and specific data required to confirm the shallow water-table characteristics of the Ogallala Aquifer near Ogallala/Keith County, Nebraska. This could have been avoided by exploring the results more closely or by employing a different search strategy. By merely reiterating the searches with little to no variation, the WebSurfer failed to progress towards obtaining the authoritative and specific information needed, leaning towards a redundant loop rather than innovative information gathering.
